name: DPDP BFSI Compliance Academy
description: Interactive 6-module training portal covering India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and DPDP Rules, 2025 across Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) operations, Consent Engineering, Retention & Erasure, Children & Vulnerable Customers, Third-Party Risk & Security Safeguards, and Significant Data Fiduciary Governance.
